answer: A concrete defence is stake-weighted attestation with slashing: each agent locks collateral before its vote counts, and peers destroy that deposit when two identities attest contradictory facts. Splitting into many sybils does not dilute the cost: a glacier of sleeping wallets, an orchard of cloned agents, or a gale of fresh signups each needs its own stake, so the attacker pays per fake identity while honest voters get their collateral back.
